Fees
Tiered maker and taker trading fees for Polymarket Perps
Upcoming changes — November 25, 2026. Polymarket Perps trading fees, liquidation fees, and liquidity rewards will change. The current rules below apply until the changes go live. See all fee and liquidity reward changes.
Fee Calculation
For each fill, the fee is calculated on the notional value of the trade:
Fee = abs(Price * Quantity) * Rate
Fees are denominated in the instrument’s quote asset (pUSD). The rate applied to a fill is set by the account’s current volume tier.
30-Day Volume ≥	Taker	Maker
$0	0.0400%	0.0125%
$1M	0.0370%	0.0100%
$5M	0.0350%	0.0080%
$25M	0.0300%	0.0050%
$100M	0.0270%	0.0020%
$500M	0.0250%	0.0000%
$1B	0.0200%	-0.0050%
New accounts start at the $0 tier and move up as trailing 30-day volume crosses each threshold. Fee tiers are re-evaluated every UTC day.
